Model scope

The particle is an isotropic, linearly magnetisable sphere with no MR-visible signal. Magnitude reflects particle partial volume and static intravoxel dephasing only. The model excludes intrinsic T₂*, diffusion, noise, chemical shift, RF and slice-profile effects, k-space point-spread functions, readout distortion and vendor phase processing.

This simulator cannot determine MRI safety. Ferromagnetic, remanently magnetised, saturated or irregular particles require a different electromagnetic model.
